items.title: Scaffold and shared contract: manifest, types, fingerprint
items.action:
Copy each planned test file this item names from docs/plans/2031/tests/<repo path> to its repo path first. (the registration test).
1. plugins/lap-stamp/.claude-plugin/plugin.json (name lap-stamp, version 0.1.0 (V7), description, author, homepage, repository, license MIT, types ./types/index.d.ts, as bubble-stamp's), hooks/hooks.json {"modules": ["./register.ts"]}, tsconfig.json and .gitignore copied from bubble-stamp.
2. types/index.d.ts, the invariant every later lane builds on: LapRow (spec D5, snake_case JSON keys: v 1, session, turn, kind 'prompt'|'wake', wake string|null, prompt_at, start_at, stop_at, last_prompt_at (ISO 8601 with local offset, string|null where D4 allows), lap_ms, since_prompt_ms number|null, reason 'answer'|'aborted'|'refusal'|'error', answer_hash string|null, answer_len); Timing (kind, wake, promptAt, startAt, stopAt, lastPromptAt, lapMs, sincePromptMs, epoch ms); ClockState (pending presses {at, origin}, running turn {turnId, startAt, attachedAt number|null, wake string|null} | null, consumedAt number|null, lastPromptAt number|null, pendingWake string|null); and the PluginState augmentation 'lap-stamp': { rows: LapRow[]; clock: ClockState; session: string | null }.
3. hooks/fingerprint.ts, pure: normalizeAnswer (drop <context>...</context> spans, CRLF to LF, trim), fnv1a64Hex, fingerprintOf(text) -> {hash, len} | null for empty normalized text (V6). hooks/fingerprint.test.ts: context spans dropped, line endings unified, known FNV-1a 64 vectors ('' -> cbf29ce484222325, 'a' -> af63dc4c8601ec8c), empty text -> null.
4. hooks/register.ts exports `register: Register = () => undefined` until TASK-9 wires it.

items.title: Clock: lap presses, turn kind and the values a row records
items.action:
1. hooks/clock.ts, pure reducers over ClockState (types/index.d.ts): LAP_PRESS_ORIGINS = ['composer', 'bridge'] (V1); submitted(state, {originKind, at}) queues a lap press or, for any other origin, sets pendingWake; delivered(state, at) attaches a press to the running turn (spec D2: it restarts that turn's lap); started(state, turnId, at) attaches the newest pending press newer than consumedAt, else marks the turn a wake with pendingWake; stopped(state, turnId, at) -> {state, timing: Timing} per D4 (prompt: lap from the attached press; wake: lap from start, since_prompt from lastPromptAt, null when none) and sets consumedAt and lastPromptAt. A stop for a turn that never started (no running turn or another id) returns timing null. seedLastPrompt(state, at) takes the newest prompt_at read back from the JSONL (D4).
2. hooks/clock.test.ts: idle press then turn (prompt kind, lap = stop - press); press during a run with delivery (restarts that turn's lap) and without (anchors the next turn); several presses keep the last; a task-notification start is a wake with wake 'task-notification' and since_prompt; no prompt ever gives since_prompt null; a pending press never anchors two turns; a stray stop.

items.title: Row codec: build, serialize and read back the JSONL
items.action:
1. hooks/row.ts, pure: buildRow({session, turn, timing, reason, answer}) -> LapRow, the answer fingerprinted with fingerprintOf (null hash and length 0 for empty, D8); isoLocal(ms, offsetMin) formats ISO 8601 with the local offset; rowLine(row) one JSON line; parseRows(text, session) reads a JSONL text leniently (blank, malformed, wrong-version and wrong-typed lines skipped, D10) and keeps the session's rows in file order; newestPromptAt(rows) for clock.seedLastPrompt. No paths and no prompt or answer text in a row.
2. hooks/row.test.ts: round trip, every skip case, empty answer, the offset form, session filter.

items.title: Stamp text and matching: format, candidate list, TurnDuration match
items.action:
1. hooks/stamp.ts, pure: formatDuration(ms) per V3; clockOf(iso) the local HH:MM:SS of a row's stop_at; stampText(row) 'HH:MM:SS · lap <dur>' plus ' · since prompt <dur>' on a wake row with one (D6); rowsForBlock(rows, text) -> the rows whose answer_hash and answer_len equal the block's fingerprint (empty-answer rows never match, D7); blockStamp(rows) -> one stamp for one row, 'identical replies: ' + each candidate's '<HH:MM:SS> lap <dur>[ · since prompt <dur>]' joined by ' | ' in file order for several, null for none; durationRow(rows, durationMs) -> the one row whose stop_at - start_at is within V2 of durationMs when exactly one row of the session is and it has an empty answer, else null (D8); wrapRight(text, width) splits a too-wide stamp on ' | ' into right-aligned lines, never dropping a candidate.
2. hooks/stamp.test.ts: every format band and boundary (59 s, 60 s, 3599 s, 3600 s), prompt and wake stamps, a miss, one match, three identical replies, an empty-answer row never matched by text, the TurnDuration cases (none, one empty, one answered, two in tolerance), wrapping.

items.title: Lap glue: the turn events, the laps file and the session's rows
items.action:
1. hooks/lap.ts, `registerLap(on)` (function declarations for every `$` function, as bubble-stamp): active only with .claude/harness.json (root.ts candidates, config.ts readConfig). Main loop only (agentId absent). prompt.submit -> clock.submitted with e.origin.kind and the wall clock; session.append with door 'delivery' or 'queue' and a lap-press origin while a main turn runs -> clock.delivered (the delivery signal TASK-10 confirms); turn.start -> clock.started; turn.complete -> clock.stopped, buildRow with e.answer and e.reason, append rowLine to <state_dir>/lap-stamp/laps.jsonl (creating the folder), push the row onto the 'lap-stamp' rows atom. session.start and session.attach read the file once, parseRows for the session id, seed the atom and clock.seedLastPrompt (D9). Every hook awaits next first and swallows its own failures (D10); nothing is written into any reply, prompt or transcript row.
2. hooks/lap.test.ts (engine-level, claude-code/testing as bubble-stamp's stamp.test.ts): a prompted turn appends one row with kind prompt; a task-notification turn appends a wake row with since_prompt; a subagent turn appends nothing; a refused write keeps the atom row and throws nothing; a restart reads the rows back; no harness.json, no file.

items.title: Render: right-aligned stamps under matched replies and TurnDuration lines
items.action:
1. hooks/render.tsx, `registerRender(on)`: ui.render on {component: 'AssistantMessage'} reads the 'lap-stamp' rows atom only (no file I/O, D9), and when blockStamp(rowsForBlock(rows, e.text)) is not null returns the original tree with right-aligned Text rows under it, drawn in STAMP_COLOR ('#B7410E', rust; EX5) (wrapRight); isSummary and onScreen pass through unchanged. ui.render on {component: 'TurnDuration'} draws durationRow's stamp right-aligned on the same row. Any miss or error renders next(e) untouched. The atom read makes a new row redraw the latest reply.
2. hooks/render.test.tsx (as parallel2-lanes band.test.tsx): a matched block gains the stamp row; a miss and a summary row are untouched; identical replies draw the candidate list; a TurnDuration line with one empty-answer row in tolerance gains a stamp, an answered one does not.

anchors.expect: const runsAtom = atom({ plugin: 'parallel2-lanes', key: 'runs' } as const, [])

items.title: Wire the mod and prove a turn end to end
items.action:
1. hooks/register.ts: `register: Register = on => { registerLap(on); registerRender(on) }`.
2. hooks/register.test.tsx: one engine drives prompt.submit, turn.start, turn.complete with an answer, then renders an AssistantMessage with that text: the laps file holds one row and the block draws 'HH:MM:SS · lap <dur>' right-aligned; a second identical reply draws the candidate list; a wake turn draws since prompt.

items.title: Live-session confirmation of the host facts the design reads
items.action: The developer runs a session with `claude --plugin-dir plugins/lap-stamp` (CLAUDE.md: local plugin edits are exercised this way before merge) and confirms, with the session's help: (a) the drawn AssistantMessage text of a reply's last block fingerprints equal to turn.complete's answer (spec Left to the builder); (b) prompt.submit fires at Enter for a queued composer prompt, and the session.append door that marks its delivery into a running turn; (c) the bridge and slash-command origin kinds (D1); (d) the TurnDuration props (D8); (e) whether --resume keeps the session id. A fact that differs goes to DesignEvolution through evolution_api and its fix is recorded with --cite, never by editing the plan.
